reading.body:
Microsoft does not publish power capacity, square footage, or exact location for individual Azure data center campuses, disclosing only aggregate worldwide statistics across 80+ regions and 500+ datacenters. This West Des Moines campus in Dallas County is therefore unquantifiable from operator sources despite being part of a multi-county investment reportedly worth $1.5–2 billion with plans for a sixth data center building.

Iowa has 52 mapped data center facilities, but only 2 have published power figures in operator disclosures, totaling 18 MW. This campus ranks third by published capacity in the state, though that ranking reflects the absence of figures from other major operators rather than a disclosed figure for this site.

The inability to read this campus's power draw or IT load means its scaling trajectory cannot be assessed from published facts. Whether it matters to AI compute supply depends on undisclosed specifications that Microsoft does not release at the individual facility level.
